name: France
notes: Drive times are typical winter times with clear roads, not Saturday change-over traffic. Prices are indicative bands. Verify before booking.

locations.name: Chamonix
locations.character: Busy mountaineering town under Mont Blanc. Steep, high terrain and huge off-piste, spread over separate areas joined by bus.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15. Train via Saint-Gervais–Le Fayet.

locations.name: Les Houches
locations.character: Quiet village with tree-lined slopes, the sheltered choice on stormy days. Ten minutes from Chamonix.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h. Mont-Blanc Express train stops here.

locations.name: Megève
locations.character: Smart medieval village with fur coats and fine dining. Gentle, scenic cruising across a very large area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h10. Bus from Sallanches station.

locations.name: Saint-Gervais
locations.character: Old spa town with a gondola straight into the Megève ski area. Real town life, lower prices than Megève.
locations.transfer: Léman Express train to Le Fayet, then bus.

links.note: Gondola into the Évasion Mont-Blanc area

locations.name: Combloux
locations.character: Sunny little village with the best Mont Blanc view in the area. Linked by lift to Megève.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h. Bus from Sallanches.

links.note: Ski across to Megève

locations.name: Les Contamines
locations.snowNote: Holds snow well for its height.
locations.character: Traditional village at the end of a valley. Holds snow well for its height and stays calm at weekends.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15. Bus from Le Fayet station.

locations.name: Morzine
locations.character: Lively market town that works all year. Big chalet scene, lots of English spoken, gateway to Avoriaz and Les Gets.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15. Bus from Thonon or Cluses stations.

locations.name: Avoriaz
locations.easyStart: Car-free village with beginner zones and a kids' village at the door.
locations.snowNote: High village, ski to the door.
locations.character: Car-free, ski-in ski-out village on a cliff top. The most snow-sure base in the Portes du Soleil.
locations.transfer: Shuttle to Morzine, then cable car or road up.

links.note: Prodains cable car or Super-Morzine gondola

locations.name: Les Gets
locations.easyStart: Nursery slopes in the village centre, a short walk from most chalets.
locations.character: Pretty, family-minded village with easy slopes on both sides. Linked to Morzine.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h. Bus from Cluses station.

links.note: Chairlifts over Le Pléney, or the shuttle bus

locations.name: Châtel
locations.character: Working farm village with direct lifts into the Swiss side of the Portes du Soleil.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30. Bus from Thonon station.

locations.name: La Chapelle-d'Abondance
locations.character: Quiet valley village with its own slopes and a free bus to Châtel.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h20. Bus from Thonon or Évian.

locations.name: Roc d'Enfer
locations.character: Small, wild area loved by locals. No crowds and cheap passes. Morzine is 15 minutes up the road.

locations.name: Thollon-les-Mémises
locations.character: Balcony above Lake Geneva with views across to Switzerland. Simple, friendly and cheap.
locations.transfer: Train to Évian, then bus or taxi.

locations.name: Bernex
locations.character: Tiny family hill above Évian. Good for a first week on skis.

locations.name: Flaine
locations.easyStart: Compact, car-free village with the beginner area right outside.
locations.snowNote: High north-facing bowl that holds snow well.
locations.character: Car-free Bauhaus-designed resort in a high, snowy bowl. Ski to the door, little to do at night.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h10. Bus from Cluses station.

locations.name: Samoëns
locations.character: Listed stone village with shops and restaurants. Gondola up into the Grand Massif.

links.note: Gondola then skiing across the Grand Massif

locations.name: Les Carroz
locations.character: Friendly wooded village, the quickest road access to the Grand Massif.

links.note: Skiable link to Flaine

locations.name: Morillon
locations.character: Valley village with a gondola to a sunny beginner plateau. Cheapest way into the Grand Massif.

links.note: Gondola to Morillon 1100, then ski across the Grand Massif

locations.name: Sixt-Fer-à-Cheval
locations.character: Remote village at the head of the Giffre valley, linked to the Grand Massif by a long scenic run.

locations.name: La Clusaz
locations.character: Lively Aravis village with five connected mountains. Busy with Annecy and Geneva locals at weekends.
locations.transfer: Bus from Annecy station about 50 min.

locations.name: Le Grand-Bornand
locations.easyStart: Gentle beginner areas at the foot of the village in Chinaillon.
locations.character: Working farm village in Reblochon country. Very family-focused with good beginner zones.
locations.transfer: Bus from Annecy station about 50 min.

locations.name: Praz de Lys–Sommand
locations.easyStart: Small plateau village with easy slopes right beside it.
locations.character: High, snow-sure plateau with easy slopes and long cross-country loops.

locations.name: Les Brasses
locations.character: Low, local family area 40 minutes from Geneva. Best after a fresh fall.

locations.name: Hirmentaz–Les Habères
locations.character: Nearest real slopes to Geneva. Ideal for a day trip or a first week.

locations.name: Le Semnoz
locations.character: Small summit area above Annecy with lake and Mont Blanc views. A day-trip hill.

locations.name: Les Saisies
locations.easyStart: Wide, gentle slopes run right through the village.
locations.character: High, sunny pastures with wide easy runs. Olympic cross-country venue.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30. Bus from Albertville station.

locations.name: Crest-Voland
locations.easyStart: Small village with easy slopes right beside it.
locations.character: Small family village, a cheaper door into the Espace Diamant.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes across the Espace Diamant

locations.name: Praz-sur-Arly
locations.character: Valley village five minutes below Megève, linked by lift to the Espace Diamant.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes across the Espace Diamant

locations.name: Arêches-Beaufort
locations.character: Unspoilt Beaufortain village. Great off-piste and almost no new building.

locations.name: Monts Jura
locations.character: Jura ridge looking straight down on Geneva and across to Mont Blanc. Thirty minutes from the airport.

locations.name: Les Rousses
locations.character: Gentle Franco-Swiss area, better known for cross-country than downhill.
locations.transfer: Car recommended. Train to La Cure from Nyon.

locations.name: La Féclaz
locations.character: Plateau above Chambéry and Aix-les-Bains. Mostly cross-country with some easy downhill.

locations.name: Aillons-Margériaz
locations.character: Small, low-key area in the Bauges nature park.

locations.name: La Plagne
locations.easyStart: Beginner areas with free lifts at the door of the main villages.
locations.character: Ten villages spread across a huge, mostly intermediate area. Built for skiing first.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Train to Aime, then bus.

locations.name: Les Arcs
locations.easyStart: Beginner areas at the door in Arc 1800 and Arc 1600.
locations.character: Purpose-built villages with a funicular from Bourg-Saint-Maurice station. Steep terrain up top.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Train to Bourg-Saint-Maurice, then funicular.

locations.name: Peisey-Vallandry
locations.character: Wooded, quieter corner of Paradiski. The Vanoise Express links Les Arcs and La Plagne here.

links.note: Chairlifts up to the Arc 1600 and 1800 slopes
Vanoise Express cable car

locations.name: Montchavin–Les Coches
locations.easyStart: Family beginner area right in front of the village.
locations.character: Old hamlet turned family resort on the La Plagne side of Paradiski.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes over to Plagne Bellecôte

locations.name: Champagny-en-Vanoise
locations.character: Sunny, authentic back door into La Plagne. Much cheaper than the main resort.

links.note: Gondola up to La Plagne

locations.name: Val d'Isère
locations.easyStart: Beginner area with free lifts at the foot of the village.
locations.character: Big-name resort with serious terrain, late snow and a strong après scene.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h. Train to Bourg-Saint-Maurice, then bus.

locations.name: Tignes
locations.easyStart: Free beginner lifts beside the lake in Tignes le Lac.
locations.character: High, glacier-backed resort. One of the most snow-sure places in France.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h. Train to Bourg-Saint-Maurice, then bus.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes over the Tovière ridge

locations.name: Courchevel
locations.easyStart: Free beginner lifts beside the village in Courchevel 1850 and 1650.
locations.character: Very smart, very expensive. Perfect grooming and the gateway to the world's largest linked area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Train to Moûtiers, then bus.

locations.name: Méribel
locations.character: Chalet-style village in the middle of the 3 Vallées. Strong British presence.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Train to Moûtiers, then bus.

locations.name: Val Thorens
locations.easyStart: Free beginner area in the middle of the resort, skis on at the door.
locations.character: Highest resort in Europe. Reliable snow, big parties, little charm.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h45. Train to Moûtiers, then bus.

locations.name: Les Menuires
locations.easyStart: Beginner zones in the resort centre, ski-in ski-out.
locations.character: Practical, value base in the 3 Vallées. Ski to Val Thorens in minutes.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Train to Moûtiers, then bus.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes up the valley

locations.name: Valmorel
locations.easyStart: Pedestrian village street with the beginner area at its foot.
locations.character: Car-free family village built around one pedestrian street.

locations.name: La Rosière
locations.easyStart: Beginner area at the front of the village, sunny and gentle.
locations.character: Sunny balcony facing the sun, linked over the border to La Thuile in Italy.

locations.name: Sainte-Foy-Tarentaise
locations.character: Small, quiet resort with legendary off-piste and almost no queues.

locations.name: Valloire
locations.character: Lively, real village with a church square and shops. Linked to Valmeinier.

locations.name: Valmeinier
locations.easyStart: Beginner area at the foot of Valmeinier 1800.
locations.character: Quiet, high station on the cheaper side of Galibier-Thabor.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes over the Crey du Quart

locations.name: Orelle
locations.character: Tiny valley village with a long gondola up to Val Thorens. The cheapest door into the 3 Vallées.

links.note: Orelle gondola

locations.name: Les Karellis
locations.easyStart: Compact resort, beginner slopes beside the apartments.
locations.snowNote: North-facing slopes that hold snow well.
locations.character: Friendly, family-run resort high above the valley. No through traffic.

locations.name: La Toussuire
locations.easyStart: Gentle beginner slopes at the front of the village.
locations.character: Big, open, sunny area. Good value family skiing.

locations.name: Le Corbier
locations.easyStart: Car-free blocks with the beginner area at the door.
locations.character: Car-free, ski-in ski-out blocks in the middle of Les Sybelles.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes across Les Sybelles

locations.name: Aussois
locations.easyStart: Beginner area at the edge of the village.
locations.character: Sunny, authentic village facing the Vanoise peaks.

locations.name: La Norma
locations.easyStart: Car-free village with beginner slopes at the door.
locations.character: Car-free family resort in a forest bowl above Modane.

locations.name: Val Cenis
locations.easyStart: Beginner areas beside the villages of Lanslevillard and Lanslebourg.
locations.character: Chain of old villages in the upper Maurienne. Long, easy runs and few crowds.

locations.name: Bonneval-sur-Arc
locations.character: One of France's prettiest stone villages. High, snowy and tiny.

locations.name: Alpe d'Huez
locations.easyStart: Large, free beginner area just above the village centre.
locations.character: Huge, sunny area with very long runs, including the 16 km Sarenne. Lively at night.
locations.transfer: Train to Grenoble, then bus about 1h30.

locations.name: Vaujany
locations.character: Quiet village with a big cable car straight into the Alpe d'Huez area.

links.note: Vaujany cable car

locations.name: Les 2 Alpes
locations.easyStart: Free beginner lifts in the village centre.
locations.character: Long, narrow ski area topped by a glacier. Big party scene.
locations.transfer: Train to Grenoble, then bus about 1h45.

locations.name: La Grave
locations.character: Legendary off-piste with one lift and almost no grooming. For strong skiers with a guide.

locations.name: Chamrousse
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes at the door in Roche Béranger and Recoin.
locations.character: Grenoble's local resort with Olympic history and big views.

locations.name: Les Sept Laux
locations.character: Good value area between Grenoble and Chambéry, busy at weekends.

locations.name: Villard-de-Lans
locations.character: Family town on the Vercors plateau with big cross-country trails.

locations.name: Serre Chevalier
locations.character: Long valley of villages and larch forests. Good skiing in bad weather.

locations.name: Montgenèvre
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes in the middle of the village.
locations.character: Border village linked to the Italian Milky Way area. Very snowy.
locations.transfer: Train to Oulx in Italy, then bus.

locations.name: Puy-Saint-Vincent
locations.easyStart: Beginner area at the foot of Puy-Saint-Vincent 1600.
locations.snowNote: North-facing slopes that hold snow well.
locations.character: Quiet family resort at the gate of the Écrins park. Great value and good snow.

locations.name: Vars
locations.easyStart: Beginner area at the front of Vars Les Claux.
locations.character: High, sunny resort in the southern Alps, linked to Risoul.
locations.transfer: Train to Embrun or Montdauphin, then bus.

locations.name: Risoul
locations.easyStart: Car-free village with the beginner area at the door.
locations.character: Car-free, purpose-built village among larch trees. Good value.

links.note: Chairlifts and pistes across the Forêt Blanche

locations.name: Les Orres
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes at the foot of Les Orres 1650.
locations.character: Sunny family resort above Lake Serre-Ponçon.

locations.name: Annecy
locations.character: Lakeside city with canals, an old town and real nightlife. Ski by day, city by night.
locations.transfer: Bus from the airport about 1h. Car 45 min.

locations.name: Thônes
locations.character: Market town at the foot of the Aravis. Supermarkets, cheese shops and local prices.

locations.name: Sallanches
locations.character: Real valley town with big views of Mont Blanc. Rail station and everyday prices.
locations.transfer: Léman Express L3 from Geneva about 1h20.

locations.name: Saint-Gervais–Le Fayet
locations.character: Rail hub below Saint-Gervais. Trains up the Chamonix valley and a rack railway into the Les Houches slopes.
locations.transfer: Léman Express L3 terminus, about 1h30 from Geneva.

locations.name: Cluses
locations.character: Plain industrial town on the motorway. Cheap beds and buses to four ski areas.
locations.transfer: Léman Express L3 from Geneva about 1h.

locations.name: Taninges
locations.character: Old village at a crossroads between the Grand Massif and the Portes du Soleil.

locations.name: Montriond
locations.character: Calm village next to Morzine with its own lift into Avoriaz. Morzine access at lower prices.

links.note: Ardent gondola

locations.name: Thonon-les-Bains
locations.character: Lakeside town with shops, markets and year-round life. Buses up to the Portes du Soleil.
locations.transfer: Léman Express L1 direct from Geneva about 50 min.

locations.name: Évian-les-Bains
locations.character: Elegant spa town on Lake Geneva. Ferries to Lausanne and quick access to the Chablais hills.
locations.transfer: Léman Express L1 direct from Geneva about 1h.

locations.name: Annemasse
locations.character: Geneva's French twin town. Cheapest beds near the airport and the main Léman Express hub.
locations.transfer: Léman Express from Geneva about 20 min.

locations.name: Bonneville
locations.character: Small administrative town in the Arve valley. Central for the Aravis and Grand Massif.
locations.transfer: Léman Express L3 from Geneva about 45 min.

locations.name: La Roche-sur-Foron
locations.character: Medieval town and rail junction. Easy reach of the Aravis and the Chablais family hills.
locations.transfer: Léman Express from Geneva about 35 min.

locations.name: Gex
locations.character: Pays de Gex town at the foot of the Jura. Ten minutes from the Monts Jura lifts.

locations.name: Divonne-les-Bains
locations.character: Spa town with a lake, casino and good restaurants. Between Geneva and the Jura slopes.

locations.name: Albertville
locations.character: Former Olympic host city at the meeting of four valleys. Good value and good shops.
locations.transfer: Train via Annecy or Chambéry about 2h. Car 1h15.

locations.name: Moûtiers
locations.character: Small valley town at the foot of the 3 Vallées. Shuttle buses to every resort above it.
locations.transfer: Train via Annecy or Chambéry about 2h30. Car 2h.

locations.name: Brides-les-Bains
locations.character: Quiet spa village with a gondola straight up to Méribel. 3 Vallées skiing at valley prices.
locations.transfer: Train to Moûtiers, then bus 15 min.

links.note: Olympe gondola

locations.name: Aime-la-Plagne
locations.character: Small Tarentaise town with a station. Short bus rides up to La Plagne villages.

locations.name: Bourg-Saint-Maurice
locations.character: Lively valley town with a funicular to Les Arcs in seven minutes. Best-value base in the upper Tarentaise.

links.note: Funicular from the station

locations.name: Chambéry
locations.character: Historic capital of Savoie. City life and cheap stays, with small family areas 30 minutes away.

locations.name: Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne
locations.character: Valley capital of the Maurienne. Station, shops and everyday prices.

locations.name: Saint-Michel-de-Maurienne
locations.character: Small town at the foot of the Galibier road, with buses up to Valloire.

locations.name: Modane
locations.character: Border town with fast trains. Short bus rides to four quiet resorts.

locations.name: Grenoble
locations.character: Big university city. City life, cheap stays and buses to six ski areas.

locations.name: Le Bourg-d'Oisans
locations.character: Valley village at the foot of the Alpe d'Huez hairpins. Buses up to two big areas.

locations.name: Briançon
locations.character: Fortified old town, the highest city in France. A gondola from town into Serre Chevalier.

links.note: Prorel gondola from town

locations.name: L'Argentière-les-Écrins
locations.character: Small station town below the Écrins. The cheapest base for Puy-Saint-Vincent.

locations.name: Embrun
locations.character: Old hilltop town by Lake Serre-Ponçon. Central for three southern resorts.
